Improving life by making rapid testing accessible to all

# Lateral Flow CDMO Services | US & UK Development & Manufacturing

From our US and UK locations, Abingdon Health provides end-to-end lateral flow development,
manufacturing and regulatory solutions under one roof.

Our integrated approach streamlines your journey from concept to commercialisation, eliminating the
inefficiencies of managing multiple vendors.

[Find Out More][41]
[triple-flags]

# Complete Lateral Flow Solutions

Development, Scale-Up & Manufacturing, Regulatory and Performance Evaluation all under one roof
ensuring seamless and parallel workstreams.

We specialise in rapid diagnostics development, helping pharma, biotech and diagnostic companies
develop products from concept to launch, and navigate FDA and global approval pathways with
integrated CDMO services designed for speed and regulatory compliance.

[Find Out More][42]
[DI9A8463-Manuf-Packaging-scaled-720×500-c-default]

# US & UK Locations

Abingdon Health’s dual UK/US development & manufacturing capabilities provide customers with
significant flexibility in building their growth plans. 

Learn more about our [US-based lateral flow CDMO capabilities][43], from Madison, Wisconsin:
* Tariff-free domestic production
* FDA-ready quality systems
* NIH/BARDA grant compliance

[Get In Touch][44]

### Lateral Flow Services

Flexible rapid test development and manufacturing services alongside reader customisation and
value-added support services.

Click on one of the icons to the left to read about our services.


### Full Service

We support your lateral flow assay from concept to launch and beyond.

[Learn more][45]


### Contract LFT Development

We are experts in design for manufacture, reagent assessment & evaluation of materials for prototype
development for Proof of Concept & Optimisation of your device to Design Freeze.

### Scale Up & Technical Transfer

## Empowering a sustainable future for our planet

Agilent supports more than 285,000 laboratories across 110 countries—advancing scientific discovery
and innovation on a global scale.

The Agilent Foundation partners with organizations that advance STEM education, promote global
wellbeing, and build climate resilience.

Agilent is advancing science with purpose—embedding circular economy principles to drive sustainable
innovation and long-term impact.

Agilent is deepening its collaboration with My Green Lab as a top-tier Transformative Sponsor, while
expanding our portfolio of ACT-labeled products to support more sustainable science.

# Customized. Sensitive. Fast.

Your drug-discovery breakthrough depends on accurate biomarker testing results. At **Ampersand
Biosciences**, we’re committed to understanding your research goals as well as you do. It’s how we
deliver customized immunoassay kits and testing services that bring your science closer to market.

## Sample Testing

Have a Luminex or ELISA assay you would like us to test for purity, safety, potency, and yield?
We’ll test samples of mouse, rat, hamster, canine, and human biomarker samples using validated assay
and GLP protocols.

[Sample Testing Services][34]

## Assay Development

We offer Luminex Multiplex Assay Development and ELISA development for application-specific
solutions to fit your unique use cases.

[Assay Development Services][35]

## View All Services

[Services][36]

## Antibodies & Proteins

We package and sell both monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies that are validated with native samples
and undergo rigorous validation prior to release. We also have recombinant proteins available for
Western Blot and ELISA antibody assay testing.

[Antibody & Protein Products][37]

## Luminex Kits

Our Luminex Multiplex Cytokine Panels are available in a standard well plate or a 96 well plate. We
validate all kits for cross-reactivity, linearity, precision, and stability. New lots undergo
bridging studies to ensure excellent lot-to-lot reproducibility.

[Luminex xMap Products][38]

## View All Products

[Products][39]

## Why Choose Ampersand Biosciences?
* ### Experience.
  
  The Ampersand Biosciences team has decades of expertise in developing and validating Luminex-based
  and other multiplex assays, antibodies, and proteins.
* ### Independence.
  
  As a privately owned women business enterprise (WBE), we answer to ourselves—not a distant
  corporate headquarters. And because we’re independent, our costs are often lower than larger
  providers.
* ### One-of-a-kind.
  
  Our newly developed ferret cytokine panels—the first on the market—provide an important tool to
  evaluate the immune response to influenza as well as other respiratory diseases. We’re constantly
  evaluating ways to meet your pre-clinical research needs: Our hamster cytokine panels for
  evaluating COVID response are the only ones available.
* ### Speed.
  
  If you have limited experience performing multiplex immunoassays, turn to Ampersand Biosciences.
  We’ll execute your experiment in our secure facility located in a remote part of Northern New
  York, saving you time and money. We can complete most projects in 2–4 months.
* ### Quality.
  
  Your experiments depend on replicable, reliable data. (We know the frustration of encountering
  antibodies that don’t work—that’s one reason why we started producing some of the ones we rely on
  in-house.)

## Grants & Research Section

Our team has decades of combined experience and is a driving force in pharmaceutical research.
Ampersand Bio is a two time winner for the SBIR grant and has been published or cited in many
academic papers.

[More About Our Research][40]

Ampersand Biosciences was the recipient of the SBIR award in 2020, 2022, 2024 for immunologic
analysis of non-mammalian and underrepresented mammalian models with a focus on several infectious
diseases including influenza and SARS-Cov-2. Through these awarded grants, Ampersand Biosciences has
been able to develop reagents to better understand and describe immune response to infection and
support biomarker and countermeasure development through immunological research.

[Read more][41]

## Conferences & Events Section

MA.

[Home – IMMUNOLOGY2026™][43]

This event, the annual meeting of the American Association of Immunologists, is the world’s leading
all-immunology event.

[Click Here for More][44]

[View Distributors][45]

# Customized. Sensitive. Fast.

Your drug-discovery breakthrough depends on accurate biomarker testing results. At **Ampersand
Biosciences**, we’re committed to understanding your research goals as well as you do. It’s how we
deliver customized immunoassay kits and testing services that bring your science closer to market.

## Sample Testing

Have a Luminex or ELISA assay you would like us to test for purity, safety, potency, and yield?
We’ll test samples of mouse, rat, hamster, canine, and human biomarker samples using validated assay
and GLP protocols.

[Sample Testing Services][34]

## Assay Development

We offer Luminex Multiplex Assay Development and ELISA development for application-specific
solutions to fit your unique use cases.

[Assay Development Services][35]

## View All Services

[Services][36]

## Antibodies & Proteins

We package and sell both monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies that are validated with native samples
and undergo rigorous validation prior to release. We also have recombinant proteins available for
Western Blot and ELISA antibody assay testing.

[Antibody & Protein Products][37]

## Luminex Kits

Our Luminex Multiplex Cytokine Panels are available in a standard well plate or a 96 well plate. We
validate all kits for cross-reactivity, linearity, precision, and stability. New lots undergo
bridging studies to ensure excellent lot-to-lot reproducibility.

[Luminex xMap Products][38]

## View All Products

[Products][39]

## Why Choose Ampersand Biosciences?
* ### Experience.
  
  The Ampersand Biosciences team has decades of expertise in developing and validating Luminex-based
  and other multiplex assays, antibodies, and proteins.
* ### Independence.
  
  As a privately owned women business enterprise (WBE), we answer to ourselves—not a distant
  corporate headquarters. And because we’re independent, our costs are often lower than larger
  providers.
* ### One-of-a-kind.
  
  Our newly developed ferret cytokine panels—the first on the market—provide an important tool to
  evaluate the immune response to influenza as well as other respiratory diseases. We’re constantly
  evaluating ways to meet your pre-clinical research needs: Our hamster cytokine panels for
  evaluating COVID response are the only ones available.
* ### Speed.
  
  If you have limited experience performing multiplex immunoassays, turn to Ampersand Biosciences.
  We’ll execute your experiment in our secure facility located in a remote part of Northern New
  York, saving you time and money. We can complete most projects in 2–4 months.
* ### Quality.
  
  Your experiments depend on replicable, reliable data. (We know the frustration of encountering
  antibodies that don’t work—that’s one reason why we started producing some of the ones we rely on
  in-house.)

## Grants & Research Section

Our team has decades of combined experience and is a driving force in pharmaceutical research.
Ampersand Bio is a two time winner for the SBIR grant and has been published or cited in many
academic papers.

[More About Our Research][40]

Ampersand Biosciences was the recipient of the SBIR award in 2020, 2022, 2024 for immunologic
analysis of non-mammalian and underrepresented mammalian models with a focus on several infectious
diseases including influenza and SARS-Cov-2. Through these awarded grants, Ampersand Biosciences has
been able to develop reagents to better understand and describe immune response to infection and
support biomarker and countermeasure development through immunological research.

[Read more][41]

## Conferences & Events Section

### [Immunology 2026][42]

MA.

[Home – IMMUNOLOGY2026™][43]

This event, the annual meeting of the American Association of Immunologists, is the world’s leading
all-immunology event.

[Click Here for More][44]

[View Distributors][45]

* [[COVID-19 Antigen Rapid Test Kit]][29]
  
  ## [COVID-19 Antigen Rapid Test Kit][30]
  
  The COVID-19 Antigen Rapid Test Kit is an immunochromatographic intended for the direct and
  qualitative detection of SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid antigens in nasopharyngeal swab and oropharyngeal
  swab from individuals who are suspected of COVID-19 by their healthcare provider.
  [Read More][31]
* [[Enterovirus 71(EV71) IgM ELISA Kit]][32]
  
  ## [Enterovirus 71(EV71) IgM ELISA Kit][33]
  
  Enterovirus 71 IgM (EV71-IgM) ELISA kit is an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay for the
  qualitative detection of IgM-class antibodies to Enterovirus 71 in human serum or plasma.
  [Read More][34]
* [[Epstein Barr virus EA IgA ELISA Kit]][35]
  
  ## [Epstein Barr virus EA IgA ELISA Kit][36]
  
  It is used for qualitative detection of IgA-class antibodies to Epstein-barr virus early antigen
  in human serum or plasma. It is intended to be used in clinical laboratories for diagnosis and
  management of patients related to infection with Epstein-barr virus.
  [Read More][37]
* [[Hepatitis E virus IgM Test Cassette(Colloidal gold)]][38]
  
  ## [Hepatitis E virus IgM Test Cassette(Colloidal gold)][39]
  
  Hepatitis E virus IgM Test Cassette is used for qualitatively detection of Hepatitis E Virus IgM
  antibodies in human serum, plasma (EDTA, heparin, sodium citrate) or whole blood (EDTA, heparin,
  sodium citrate). The test is to be used as an aid in the diagnosis of viral hepatitis, which is
  caused by Hepatitis E Virus.
  [Read More][40]

# Rapid tests, made to measure.

Nanoparticle innovation
ready for field use.

[Learn More][27]
[Close up of hand interacting with test]

## Draw on our deep expertise across industries.

Translate your project needs into precision-engineered diagnostic assays for diverse applications,
including medicine, veterinary care, food industry, pharmaceuticals, industrial monitoring,
environmental, and biodefense.
* [Woman with stethoscope treating patient]
* [Man with livestock holding tablet]
* [Woman in safety vest and construction helmet holding tablet]

## Capabilities

BioAssay Works has a a 20+ year proven track record of providing custom, turnkey lateral flow assay
solutions for leading-edge companies.
* ### Services
  
  We offer custom assay development, contract manufacturing, and custom gold conjugation services
  that align seamlessly with your vision and goals.
  
  [Learn More][28]
* ### Products
  
  Our products leverage core technologies to help our customers bring lab-based assay sensitivity to
  point-of-care, rapid assays.
  
  [Learn More][29]

## What our customers say

> Working with Bioassay Works (BAW) delivered us top notch efficiency, improved assay performance
> and reduced development cost. Undoubtedly, BAW was a stellar product development partner that
> brought special touch of quality, responsiveness and dedication to our project, which allowed us
> to rapidly advance our product to market.”
> 
> Manufacturer of novel diagnostic tests for unmet global health needs

## News and
## Announcements
* ## Visit us at ADLM 2026 Clinical Lab Expo in Anaheim
  
  July 2026
  
  Anaheim, CA
  
  BioAssay Works will be exhibiting at Booth #2069 during the Clinical Lab Expo, July 28-30. Come
  talk with our team about custom LFA development and manufacturing. [(more…)][30]
* ## Join us at MEDICA 2025
  
  November 17-19, 2025
  
  Düsseldorf, Germany
  
  BioAssay Works is excited to announce our participation on November 17-19 at MEDICA 2025! Visit
  our booth in Hall 3 / C40-6. [(more…)][31]
* ## BioAssay Works Celebrates 20 Years
  
  Ijamsville, MD
  
  BioAssay Works proudly marks its 20th anniversary of being at the forefront of reagent innovation
  and customized development and manufacturing services. [(more…)][32]

## Articles
* [Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADC) —a monoclonal antibody with a cytotoxic payload —moving towards a
  cancer cell target.]
  
  ## Two Molecules, One Test: What ADCs Demand from Identity Testing
  
  ADCs have changed the requirements for identity testing. Unlike conventional monoclonal
  antibodies, they require manufacturers to confirm two independently variable molecular components
  within a single therapeutic product while distinguishing that product from an increasingly complex
  portfolio of related molecules. [(more…)][33]
* ## Biotherapeutic Identity Testing: From Novel Concept to Mission-Critical Manufacturing
  ## Requirement
  
  As biologics portfolios expand, identity testing has shifted from a regulatory checkbox to a
  mission-critical manufacturing risk — and the tools to manage it have never been more capable.
  [(more…)][34]
* ## LFA vs ELISA: How to Choose the Right Diagnostic Method (Sensitivity, Speed & Use Case)
  
  Lateral flow assays (LFA) and enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISA) are widely used
  immunoassay techniques. Choosing the right method depends on application, sensitivity, and
  environment. Both methods have been around for over 50 years, and each has earned a well-deserved
  place in diagnostics. But they are not interchangeable — ELISA offers high sensitivity, while LFA
  provides rapid results. Understanding where each excels is critical to selecting the right tool
  for your application. [(more…)][35]

## Why Caltag?

At Caltag, we connect scientists with specialist life science reagents reliably and with expert
support. Founded in 2001 and based in Buckingham, we support researchers in the UK and Ireland,
across academia, pharma and biotech with a plethora of high-quality life science products.

But we do more than that. As the manufacturer of TransFix®, an IVD flow cytometry stabilisation
reagent that is trusted worldwide, we understand the scientific, regulatory and logistical
challenges our customers and suppliers face.

As an independent, employee-owned business, we take pride in being approachable, responsive, and
easy to work with. Our team are always happy to assist with technical queries, aid in sourcing the
correct product, and support with any logistical issues. No automated replies, no sales pressure,
just a knowledgeable team bridging science and supply, removing barriers to scientific discovery.

We also hold all the necessary ethical documentation, are ISO 13485 certified & HTA Licensed, and
maintain strict oversight of reagents entering and leaving our premises. In turn, not only can you
trust the quality of our products, but the integrity of our service too.

Whether you’re sourcing a hard-to-find reagent or need guidance on the best tool for your work,
we’re here to support your next step.

## Why Caltag?

At Caltag, we connect scientists with specialist life science reagents reliably and with expert
support. Founded in 2001 and based in Buckingham, we support researchers in the UK and Ireland,
across academia, pharma and biotech with a plethora of high-quality life science products.

But we do more than that. As the manufacturer of TransFix®, an IVD flow cytometry stabilisation
reagent that is trusted worldwide, we understand the scientific, regulatory and logistical
challenges our customers and suppliers face.

As an independent, employee-owned business, we take pride in being approachable, responsive, and
easy to work with. Our team are always happy to assist with technical queries, aid in sourcing the
correct product, and support with any logistical issues. No automated replies, no sales pressure,
just a knowledgeable team bridging science and supply, removing barriers to scientific discovery.

We also hold all the necessary ethical documentation, are ISO 13485 certified & HTA Licensed, and
maintain strict oversight of reagents entering and leaving our premises. In turn, not only can you
trust the quality of our products, but the integrity of our service too.

Whether you’re sourcing a hard-to-find reagent or need guidance on the best tool for your work,
we’re here to support your next step.

You can register on our website using the exact company name that is on your company's W-9 or
corporate return. Start off by verify your company's address, fill in appropriate boxes, then click
submit. Once you are you registered you can access the website features.

What if I forgot my username/password?

If you forget your username or password, click here, enter your email address and we will email you
your account information. If you forget your email address, please contact your sales
representative.

EquipNet has been revolutionizing the way companies manage their surplus assets for over two
decades. Our clients range in size from small businesses to Fortune 500 multi-national corporations.
We manage the entire sales and redeployment process, handling a single piece of equipment, or
managing your global investment and redeployment program, including plant closures.

## Buy Equipment

EquipNet is the largest online venue for pre-owned manufacturing, packaging, laboratory, test,
electronics, and facility support equipment. Shop 1,000+ equipment categories across 3 sales
channels.

[MarketPlace™][85]

[Auctions][86]

[Own It Now™][87]

## Sell Equipment

Whether it’s a site closure, a facility reorganization, or simply surplus equipment, EquipNet will
manage the sales process ensuring maximum cash value recovered.

[List an Item for Sale][88]

[List Multiple Items For Sale][89]

[Plant Closures & Projects][90]

## Manage Equipment

EquipNet’s proprietary technology (ARMS™), along with turnkey capabilities deliver a professionally
managed investment recovery and redeployment program.

[Global Programs][91]

[Regional Programs][92]

One of our previous project clients recommended our services to Synta Pharmaceuticals to help with
closing a facility consisting of three different buildings. The entire facility needed full
clearance and contained an array of over 400 pieces of R&D equipment.
[Read More][105]

### The Success of Buying & Selling Equipment with EquipNet

EquipNet is constantly working on asset disposition projects with multiple clients across the globe
to help companies buy, sell, and manage their surplus. This case study outlines how EquipNet was
able to help our long-term client buying and selling. 
[Read More][106]

### Cookie Production Line: Colombia

This client originally sought out an auctioneer company to help sell a cookie production line from a
facility in Colombia. When the company was unsuccessful in its efforts, the auctioneer directly
reached out to EquipNet for expert assistance.

## New Ebook: How to Choose a Model Organism

# **Free Cloud-Based LIMS Software for Every Laboratory**

Replace paper records and spreadsheets with FreeLIMS to streamline the entire spectrum of lab
operations, improve efficiency, enhance data quality, and meet compliance goals.

[Get FreeLIMS][25]
[Book a LIMS Demo][26]
[FreeLIMS banner]

## Free Cloud-Based LIMS Software for Efficient Lab Management

FreeLIMS is a free, cloud-based Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) that helps
laboratories of any size automate sample management, testing workflows, inventory management,
reporting, and regulatory compliance. Securely hosted in the cloud, it replaces manual, paper-based
processes with a centralized platform accessible from anywhere.

FreeLIMS manages a sample’s entire lifecycle—from barcode-based accessioning and freezer storage
mapping to sample processing, testing, and automated report generation. It also provides an AI-ready
digital infrastructure by organizing laboratory data in a structured, centralized format, enabling
AI-powered tools to deliver meaningful insights and support informed decision-making. By
streamlining laboratory operations, FreeLIMS reduces manual errors and helps laboratories remain
audit-ready.

Unlike traditional LIMS platforms that require significant licensing fees and IT infrastructure,
FreeLIMS is available at no cost. Laboratories across a wide range of industries can streamline
operations and improve compliance without the expense and complexity of deploying and maintaining
on-premises software.

[Get FreeLIMS][27]
[Book a LIMS Demo][28]

## FreeLIMS Offers Configurable LIMS Solutions

LIMS solution for biobanks, clinical research, clinical diagnostics, genomics, biotechnology,
veterinary, and analytical testing laboratories, including cannabis, environmental, materials, food
and beverage, and water testing labs.

FreeLIMS' biobanking LIMS software helps biorepositories manage biological samples from receipt
through storage and retrieval, while supporting ISO 20387, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GDPR, and ISBER
and NCI Best Practices.

### Cannabis LIMS

FreeLIMS' cannabis LIMS software helps hemp and cannabis testing labs manage samples, automate
QA/QC, and meet ISO 17025, GLP, and state-specific regulatory requirements.

[READ MORE →][30]
[Clinical Diagnostics LIMS]

### Clinical Diagnostics LIMS

FreeLIMS' clinical diagnostics LIMS helps healthcare and pathology laboratories securely manage
patients, samples, and test results, generate custom test reports, and deliver them through secure
web portals while meeting HIPAA, CLIA, and ISO 15189 requirements.

### Clinical Research LIMS

FreeLIMS' clinical research LIMS supports CROs, clinical trial sites, and research laboratories with

## Key Benefits of FreeLIMS: A Modern, Configurable, Free Cloud-Based LIMS

[AI Icon]

#### AI-Ready Digital Infrastructure

Provides a structured digital foundation that enables AI-powered tools to seamlessly process
laboratory data. Predictive analytics help laboratory managers improve forecasting and make faster,
data-driven operational decisions.

[Comprehensive Quality Management]

#### Comprehensive Quality Management

Maintains audit trails, automates calculations, manages CAPA, flags out-of-specification results,
and enforces SOPs. This minimizes operational variability and helps ensure accurate, verifiable, and
reproducible results.

[Workflow Optimization]

#### Workflow Optimization

Matches each laboratory’s unique operational processes by digitizing step-by-step methodologies.
This ensures staff consistently follow predefined SOPs, improving efficiency, standardization, and
overall laboratory productivity.

[Sample Management]

#### Sample Management

Tracks every sample from accession through testing, storage, and disposal with complete lifecycle
traceability. It simplifies high-throughput, multi-site sample management, reduces errors, and
improves laboratory turnaround times.

[Patient Management]

#### Patient Management

Centralizes patient demographics, medical history, sample associations, and related laboratory
information in one secure system. This improves data accuracy, protects confidentiality, and enables
timely reporting.

[Storage Management]

#### Storage Management

Tracks the precise location of every sample using a searchable, hierarchical storage structure.
Virtual inventory visualization enables laboratories to instantly locate samples and optimize
storage management.

[Test-Management]

#### Test Management

Consolidates test results, analytes, custodians, consumed quantities, and completion status in one
system. This simplifies reporting, improves data accuracy, and streamlines laboratory operations.

[Role-Based-Access]

#### Role-Based Access

Controls user permissions through configurable role-based access for every laboratory activity.
Sensitive information is automatically protected, ensuring secure access and preventing unauthorized
data exposure.

[Compliance-Requirements]

#### Compliance Requirements

Manages SOPs, staff training, instrument maintenance, audit trails, electronic signatures, and
automated alerts. Helps laboratories maintain audit readiness and comply with regulatory and quality
standards.

[Patient Management]

#### Patient Portal

Allows patients to self-register, submit testing requests, and download approved diagnostic reports
online. This improves transparency, reduces administrative workload, and accelerates communication
with the laboratory.

[Physician-Portal]

#### Physician Portal

Allows healthcare providers to enter patient records, submit diagnostic test requests, and generate
sample barcodes. Physicians can monitor request status in real time and download invoices and test
reports.

[Client-Portal]

#### Client Portal

Enables clients to remotely submit samples and request testing or storage services through a secure
portal. Clients can track request status and download invoices or test reports from anywhere.

[Study-Management]

#### Study Management

Organizes research studies by linking samples, patients, and principal investigators within a single
system. Users can monitor study progress and generate customized reports for research and regulatory
purposes.

[Services-and-Billing]

#### Services & Billing Management

Digitizes laboratory service catalogs, standardizes pricing for each test, and automates order
processing submitted through the client portal. Managers can efficiently approve or reject requests
while maintaining complete billing records.

[Logistics-and-Shipment-Tracking]

#### Logistics & Shipment Tracking

Tracks sample shipments from collection through final laboratory delivery with complete visibility.
This minimizes sample loss and preserves the chain of custody throughout transportation.

[Kit-Management]

#### Kit Management

Configures testing kits, prints barcode labels, and monitors inventory using automated stock
thresholds. Proactive alerts help laboratories replenish supplies before shortages affect
operations.

[Client-Relationship-Management]

#### Client Relationship Management

Centralizes client profiles and links them directly to related laboratory records and activities.
Secure onboarding and automated notifications improve client communication while reducing
administrative effort.

Laboratories choose FreeLIMS because it delivers the core functionality of an enterprise LIMS

## Key Benefits of FreeLIMS: A Modern, Configurable, Free Cloud-Based LIMS

[AI Icon]

#### AI-Ready Digital Infrastructure

Provides a structured digital foundation that enables AI-powered tools to seamlessly process
laboratory data. Predictive analytics help laboratory managers improve forecasting and make faster,
data-driven operational decisions.

[Comprehensive Quality Management]

#### Comprehensive Quality Management

Maintains audit trails, automates calculations, manages CAPA, flags out-of-specification results,
and enforces SOPs. This minimizes operational variability and helps ensure accurate, verifiable, and
reproducible results.

[Workflow Optimization]

#### Workflow Optimization

Matches each laboratory’s unique operational processes by digitizing step-by-step methodologies.
This ensures staff consistently follow predefined SOPs, improving efficiency, standardization, and
overall laboratory productivity.

[Sample Management]

#### Sample Management

Tracks every sample from accession through testing, storage, and disposal with complete lifecycle
traceability. It simplifies high-throughput, multi-site sample management, reduces errors, and
improves laboratory turnaround times.

[Patient Management]

#### Patient Management

Centralizes patient demographics, medical history, sample associations, and related laboratory
information in one secure system. This improves data accuracy, protects confidentiality, and enables
timely reporting.

[Storage Management]

#### Storage Management

Tracks the precise location of every sample using a searchable, hierarchical storage structure.
Virtual inventory visualization enables laboratories to instantly locate samples and optimize
storage management.

[Test-Management]

#### Test Management

Consolidates test results, analytes, custodians, consumed quantities, and completion status in one
system. This simplifies reporting, improves data accuracy, and streamlines laboratory operations.

[Role-Based-Access]

#### Role-Based Access

Controls user permissions through configurable role-based access for every laboratory activity.
Sensitive information is automatically protected, ensuring secure access and preventing unauthorized
data exposure.

[Compliance-Requirements]

#### Compliance Requirements

Manages SOPs, staff training, instrument maintenance, audit trails, electronic signatures, and
automated alerts. Helps laboratories maintain audit readiness and comply with regulatory and quality
standards.

[Patient Management]

#### Patient Portal

Allows patients to self-register, submit testing requests, and download approved diagnostic reports
online. This improves transparency, reduces administrative workload, and accelerates communication
with the laboratory.

[Physician-Portal]

#### Physician Portal

Allows healthcare providers to enter patient records, submit diagnostic test requests, and generate
sample barcodes. Physicians can monitor request status in real time and download invoices and test
reports.

[Client-Portal]

#### Client Portal

Enables clients to remotely submit samples and request testing or storage services through a secure
portal. Clients can track request status and download invoices or test reports from anywhere.

[Study-Management]

#### Study Management

Organizes research studies by linking samples, patients, and principal investigators within a single
system. Users can monitor study progress and generate customized reports for research and regulatory
purposes.

[Services-and-Billing]

#### Services & Billing Management

Digitizes laboratory service catalogs, standardizes pricing for each test, and automates order
processing submitted through the client portal. Managers can efficiently approve or reject requests
while maintaining complete billing records.

[Logistics-and-Shipment-Tracking]

#### Logistics & Shipment Tracking

Tracks sample shipments from collection through final laboratory delivery with complete visibility.
This minimizes sample loss and preserves the chain of custody throughout transportation.

[Kit-Management]

#### Kit Management

Configures testing kits, prints barcode labels, and monitors inventory using automated stock
thresholds. Proactive alerts help laboratories replenish supplies before shortages affect
operations.

[Client-Relationship-Management]

#### Client Relationship Management

Centralizes client profiles and links them directly to related laboratory records and activities.
Secure onboarding and automated notifications improve client communication while reducing
administrative effort.

Laboratories choose FreeLIMS because it delivers the core functionality of an enterprise LIMS
without licensing costs or the need to manage IT infrastructure. It’s built for labs that need to
modernize quickly without a large software budget.

## Trusted Diagnostic Solutions for Infectious Diseases

Propel your testing and research endeavors forward with our extensive portfolio of proprietary
biological and technological diagnostic solutions.

[Antigens] **Antigens**

With one of the industry’s most extensive portfolios of infectious disease antigens, we provide the
viral, bacterial, and parasitic products you need to support your diagnostic goals and deliver
reliable results. Beyond diagnostics, our products are also instrumental in advancing research in
fields like epidemiology, virology, and immunology.

[EXPLORE][70]
[External Quality Controls]**External Quality Controls **

Our Quality Assessment Products (QAPs™) are expertly designed to emulate patient samples using
native pathogens or synthetic genomes. Trust in our ready-to-use solutions to enhance the precision
and reliability of your diagnostic processes.

[EXPLORE][71]
[Control Elution Buffer ]**Control Elution Buffer **

Our Control Elution Buffer is a stable sample elution buffer for control swab formulations used in
diagnostic tests. The product is commonly used as an intermediate step for preparing the control
swab formulations in validation/verification protocols including the swab sample elution step.

[EXPLORE][72]
[DxTM™ Viral Transport Medium]**DxTM™ Viral Transport Medium**

Our DxTM™ is an IVD medical device expertly designed for the secure collection and transport of
specimens and is only available for sale in Canada.

[EXPLORE][73]
[Aseptic Custom Vial Filling Services]**Vial Filling Services **

Microbix offers aseptic custom filling services in a state-of-the-art facility across a range of
fields to compliantly meet your needs on a pilot or commercial scale. The aseptic capabilities
include two types of filling lines: 10,000 vials per day or 60,000 vials per day.

[EXPLORE][74]
** Products**

## Diagnostic & Research Solutions for the Entire Healthcare Ecosystem

Microbix has a large portfolio of infectious disease antigens produced at commercial scale that
serve as key ingredients for manufacturing diagnostic tests and external quality control materials.
The antigens can also be used for vaccine R&D and applied research in microbiology, virology, cell
biology, immunology, and pathology.

[Respiratory Antigens] **Respiratory Antigens**

Our respiratory antigens cover infections such as Adenovirus, RSV, Parainfluenza 2 & 3, Flu A & B,
and Chlamydia pneumoniae for test innovation and development.


[explore][75]
[ToRCH Antigens]**ToRCH Antigens**

ToRCH infections include Toxoplasmosis, Other (Varicella Zoster virus), Syphilis, and Parvovirus
B19), Cytomegalovirus, Rubella Virus, and Herpes Simplex Virus.

[explore][76]
[Childhood Disease Antigens]**Childhood Disease Antigens**

Specialized childhood disease immunological test development for Measles, Mumps, Rubella, Varicella

# We are the Microfluidics Innovation Hub (MIH)

As part of the EU H2020 funded project NextGenMicrofluidics, the Microfluidics Innovation Hub (MIH)
offers its customers a single entry point to a wide range of existing cutting edge microfluidic
technologies from Europe’s top companies and research organizations. The MIH consolidates
technologies along the entire value chain in the development of customized microfluidic
lab-on-chip systems and offers services from the development of working prototypes towards
production and mass manufacturing.

Construct a better future

Multiplex is a premier construction company with a simple purpose: to construct a better future.

Established in Australia in 1962, Multiplex is known for shaping skylines and delivering iconic
projects around the world.

It has delivered over 1,150 projects with a combined value in excess of US$130 billion.
* [ About us ][60]
* [ Our locations ][61]

Delivering iconic projects in partnership with our clients around the world

With offices in Australia, United Kingdom, Canada and the Middle East we have a proven track record
of delivering iconic and world-class projects for public and private clients in major cities and
regional areas alike.

We seek collaborative, consultative relationships with clients and stakeholders to create common
goals, moving standards forward in every phase of programme delivery. We do this through our quality
systems, our market-leading health and safety approaches and the positive impacts we create through
our projects – on society, local communities and the environment.

Multiplex is a premier construction company with a simple purpose: to construct a better future.

Established in Australia in 1962, Multiplex is known for shaping skylines and delivering iconic
projects around the world.

It has delivered over 1,150 projects with a combined value in excess of US$130 billion.

Offices in 35 countries.

## Insights & News


###### [PerkinElmer Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report, Advancing its Commitment to Cleaner
###### Science and a More Sustainable Future][246]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical and testing solutions and pharma specialty services,
serving the life sciences, applied and industrial, and food markets, today released its second
annual Sustainability Report, detailing the company's environmental, social, and governance
performance and progress in 2025.


###### [PerkinElmer and Covalent Announce Strategic Collaboration to Advance Failure Analysis and
###### Materials Characterization for Semiconductor, Electronics, and Battery Industries][247]

PerkinElmer and Covalent today announced a strategic collaboration to provide advanced analytical
instrumentation and analysis services that address the growing complexity of failure analysis and
materials characterization.


###### [PerkinElmer Partners with eXXpedition to Advance Ocean Science and a More Sustainable
###### Future][248]

PerkinElmer, a global leader in analytical solutions that drive human and environmental health,
today announced a partnership with eXXpedition, the all-women global sailing research organization
dedicated to investigating the causes and impacts of plastic pollution in the marine environment.


###### [Project Farma Expands PMIS Offering with Oracle Primavera Cloud to Address Growing Pharma
###### Capital Project Complexity][249]

Project Farma, PerkinElmer’s patient-focused life sciences consulting firm dedicated to accelerating
manufacturing for life-changing therapies, today announced a partnership with Oracle Primavera Cloud
(OPC) to enhance its project controls and capital program delivery capabilities for pharmaceutical
and biotech organizations.

C5000 semi-automated device which quantifies biomarkers for thyroid disease, inflammation, cardiac
diseases, fertility, diabetes, bone metabolism, anemia, and health check by analyzing human serum,
plasma and whole blood.

## Why Choose C5000?

Our portable, cost-effective diagnostic device enables point-of-care testing in clinics, which saves
you the cost of using an outside lab and saves your patients valuable time while they wait for a
treatment plan.
* 01.
  [Lyophilized Reagents][68]
  
  Revolutionizing Diagnostics Logistics: The Poclight C5000 with Lyophilized Reagents The Poclight
  C5000 Chemiluminescence Immunoassay Analyzer is engineered with a dry system utilizing lyophilized
  (freeze-dried) reagents, completely eliminating the need for cold chain transportation. This
  innovation dramatically reduces shipping costs, simplifies global logistics, and enhances reagent
  stability during long-distance and high-temperature conditions. Unlike traditional systems
  requiring temperature-controlled transport, the C5000’s lyophilized reagents allow for
  room-temperature shipping, enabling portability, flexibility, and rapid deployment in both urban
  and remote regions. Whether by air, sea, or road, the C5000 supports multi-modal transportation
  for faster and more reliable international distribution—ideal for countries with limited cold
  storage infrastructure. With a compact design (only 7kg and an A4 footprint), the Poclight C5000
  is ready for point-of-care testing anywhere in the world. From clinics in developing countries to
  emergency labs in disaster zones, it ensures accurate, on-site diagnosis without logistic
  barriers.    
  
  [Read More][69]
* 02.

  Fast & Efficient: Multi-Channel Testing with Poclight C5000 The Poclight C5000 Chemiluminescence
  Immunoassay Analyzer delivers accurate diagnostic results within just 3 to 15 minutes, ensuring
  timely clinical decision-making. Equipped with 7 independent testing channels, the C5000 allows
  for simultaneous analysis of up to 7 different biomarkers—dramatically improving workflow
  efficiency in busy clinics, laboratories, and point-of-care settings. By supporting multi-analyte
  testing in parallel, the Poclight C5000 minimizes patient wait times and optimizes throughput,

  diagnostics without sacrificing accuracy. Whether for emergency departments, outpatient clinics,
  or remote healthcare sites, the C5000 empowers medical teams to screen multiple diseases at once,
  enabling faster diagnosis, earlier treatment, and improved patient outcomes.

  Global Standard Accuracy: Trusted Results with Poclight C5000 The Poclight C5000 Chemiluminescence
  Immunoassay Analyzer delivers exceptional diagnostic precision, featuring a coefficient of
  variation (CV) under 3%, ensuring stable, consistent, and reliable results across every test.
  Designed to meet international clinical standards, the C5000 demonstrates strong correlation with
  leading reference systems like Roche Cobas—giving healthcare professionals confidence that their
  results align with globally recognized benchmarks. Already trusted by laboratories and clinics in
  over 100 countries, the Poclight C5000’s proven performance and global compatibility make it an
  ideal choice for healthcare providers seeking both accuracy and scalability. Whether in advanced
  hospitals or resource-limited settings, the C5000 empowers medical teams to deliver quality
  diagnostics without compromise.
  
  [Read More][73]
* 04.
  [Compact Size][74]
  
  Compact, Portable, and Affordable: Diagnostics Made Simple with Poclight C5000 Designed for
  flexibility and convenience, the Poclight C5000 Chemiluminescence Immunoassay Analyzer features a
  compact A4-sized footprint and weighs only 7 kg, making it lightweight, portable, and easy to move
  between rooms or facilities. Whether for small clinics, mobile labs, or resource-limited
  healthcare centers, the C5000 seamlessly integrates into spaces where every centimeter matters.
  Despite its compact size, the C5000 delivers the power of advanced chemiluminescence diagnostics
  at a reasonable and affordable price point. This makes cutting-edge diagnostic technology
  accessible to primary care providers, community hospitals, and outpatient clinics that previously
  relied on outsourced testing. With the Poclight C5000, healthcare facilities can now establish
  in-house diagnostic capability, reducing outsourcing costs and turnaround times, and improving
  patient care quality.

# [Time Capsules in the Language of Science][29]

Posted on [July 23, 2026July 24, 2026][30] by [Elise Johnson][31]

In elementary school, I spent an art class layering greens. Jungle green fabric with a subtle
coordinating stripe, delicate spring green tissue paper so translucent you could see through it,
pieces of chunky emerald felt cut into the shape of leaves, sparkling seafoam and teal glitter, all
of it pressed and glued onto a piece of tagboard in what my teacher called a monochromatic collage.
All shades of one color. *Mono*: one. *Chroma*: color. I didn’t think about the word at the time
because I was too busy glittering.

That same week, I took a science quiz on monocots and dicots and got the answer wrong. I couldn’t
remember which plants had one seed leaf and which had two. When I got the test back and saw my
error, it clicked. Of course a monocot has one seed leaf. I’d been using *mono *in art class while
missing it on a science quiz down the hall. The root moved between rooms, but I hadn’t learned yet
that it could.

That stuck with me. Although my formal education is in English and linguistics, my mind naturally
sought out scientific connections. Greek and Latin roots were the place where those two interests
didn’t have to compete. They had the precision of formulas, a combinatorial logic where twenty roots
could unlock hundreds of words, and they worked on both sides of the hallway.

I write about science now, and the roots have remained my constant companion. A few weeks ago I was
researching an organism called *Rapaza viridis* for a blog post on endosymbiosis. I’d never heard of
it, but since *viridis *is Latin for green (the same root that gives us “verdant”), I already
guessed this creature had something to do with photosynthesis. It does. *R. viridis* is a
single-celled predator that steals chloroplasts from the algae it hunts and uses them to
photosynthesize.

Learning more about the organism, I came across the term “transient chimerism.” Also new to me, but
also immediately legible. The *trans *in “transient” is the same as in “transparent” and
“transport”: ‘across,’ ‘through.’ Something passing through. Chimera: the Greek monster stitched
together from a lion, a goat, and a serpent. Put together: a temporary state of being made from
parts of more than one organism. The roots came through for me once again.

This keeps happening. I’ll hit a term I’ve never seen, and its pieces already feel familiar. I could
spend this entire blog walking through terms and showing you their roots, but definitions only stay
interesting for so long (and my family already compares me to the father in *My Big Fat Greek
Wedding*). What I’ve become more interested in is something the roots do beyond defining. The roots
that end up in a name tend to carry more than a definition. They carry an interpretation, an
argument about the thing itself.

For years, I wondered about apoptosis. I knew *apo *meant ‘away from.’ I could see *ptosis *maybe
shared something with “asymptote,” but I couldn’t figure out what cell death had to do with
calculus. In 1972, John Kerr, an Australian pathologist, had been studying a form of cell death that
looked nothing like anything he’d seen before. For most of pathology’s history, the only cell death
anyone studied was the kind that showed up when something had gone wrong: a cell damaged by injury
or infection or toxins, dying violently. That kind of death had a name: necrosis, from the Greek
*nekros *(‘corpse’). The cell swells, ruptures, spills its contents, and triggers inflammation.
Studying liver tissue, Kerr noticed a second kind of death happening quietly alongside it, in cells
that hadn’t been damaged at all. The cell death he was watching was the opposite. The cell shrank,
and its contents condensed. It broke apart into tidy packages that neighboring cells quietly
absorbed. No mess. The body had planned this.

[Continue reading “Time Capsules in the Language of Science” ][32]

# [Time Capsules in the Language of Science][29]

Posted on [July 23, 2026July 24, 2026][30] by [Elise Johnson][31]

In elementary school, I spent an art class layering greens. Jungle green fabric with a subtle
coordinating stripe, delicate spring green tissue paper so translucent you could see through it,
pieces of chunky emerald felt cut into the shape of leaves, sparkling seafoam and teal glitter, all
of it pressed and glued onto a piece of tagboard in what my teacher called a monochromatic collage.
All shades of one color. *Mono*: one. *Chroma*: color. I didn’t think about the word at the time
because I was too busy glittering.

That same week, I took a science quiz on monocots and dicots and got the answer wrong. I couldn’t
remember which plants had one seed leaf and which had two. When I got the test back and saw my
error, it clicked. Of course a monocot has one seed leaf. I’d been using *mono *in art class while
missing it on a science quiz down the hall. The root moved between rooms, but I hadn’t learned yet
that it could.

That stuck with me. Although my formal education is in English and linguistics, my mind naturally
sought out scientific connections. Greek and Latin roots were the place where those two interests
didn’t have to compete. They had the precision of formulas, a combinatorial logic where twenty roots
could unlock hundreds of words, and they worked on both sides of the hallway.

I write about science now, and the roots have remained my constant companion. A few weeks ago I was
researching an organism called *Rapaza viridis* for a blog post on endosymbiosis. I’d never heard of
it, but since *viridis *is Latin for green (the same root that gives us “verdant”), I already
guessed this creature had something to do with photosynthesis. It does. *R. viridis* is a
single-celled predator that steals chloroplasts from the algae it hunts and uses them to
photosynthesize.

Learning more about the organism, I came across the term “transient chimerism.” Also new to me, but
also immediately legible. The *trans *in “transient” is the same as in “transparent” and
“transport”: ‘across,’ ‘through.’ Something passing through. Chimera: the Greek monster stitched
together from a lion, a goat, and a serpent. Put together: a temporary state of being made from
parts of more than one organism. The roots came through for me once again.

This keeps happening. I’ll hit a term I’ve never seen, and its pieces already feel familiar. I could
spend this entire blog walking through terms and showing you their roots, but definitions only stay
interesting for so long (and my family already compares me to the father in *My Big Fat Greek
Wedding*). What I’ve become more interested in is something the roots do beyond defining. The roots
that end up in a name tend to carry more than a definition. They carry an interpretation, an
argument about the thing itself.

For years, I wondered about apoptosis. I knew *apo *meant ‘away from.’ I could see *ptosis *maybe
shared something with “asymptote,” but I couldn’t figure out what cell death had to do with
calculus. In 1972, John Kerr, an Australian pathologist, had been studying a form of cell death that
looked nothing like anything he’d seen before. For most of pathology’s history, the only cell death
anyone studied was the kind that showed up when something had gone wrong: a cell damaged by injury
or infection or toxins, dying violently. That kind of death had a name: necrosis, from the Greek
*nekros *(‘corpse’). The cell swells, ruptures, spills its contents, and triggers inflammation.
Studying liver tissue, Kerr noticed a second kind of death happening quietly alongside it, in cells
that hadn’t been damaged at all. The cell death he was watching was the opposite. The cell shrank,
and its contents condensed. It broke apart into tidy packages that neighboring cells quietly
absorbed. No mess. The body had planned this.

# [New Approach Methodologies: Guidelines for Biological Ground Truths][40]

Posted on [July 16, 2026July 16, 2026][41] by [Simon Moe][42]

## FDA Regulation changes: The Problem is still Validation

In March 2026, the FDA published draft guidance that fundamentally changed how NAMs (New Approach
Methodologies) are evaluated in drug development. If you’re designing NAMs, whether that be
spheroids, organoids, or organs-on-a-chip, your model now must meet specific validation criteria set
by regulators. This draft document, titled ‘General Considerations for the Use of New Approach
Methodologies in Drug Development’ provides requirements on the use of NAMs, including in vitro, in
silico and in chemico methods (FDA & CDER, 2026). This guidance is a big shift from aspirational
recommendations towards clearer regulatory recommendations.

It comes on the coattails of consistent feedback and challenges the market has seen over the past
few years as they attempt to transition and optimize away from animal models. Mainly being:

*“How can I be sure the data I get from this non-animal model is reliable, trustworthy and
relevant?”*

This regulatory mandate from the FDA requires researchers to use models and assays that meet four
validation criteria:
* Context of use
* Human biological relevance
* Technical characterization
* Fit-for-purpose

This guidance initially applies to antibody development, biologics, and will eventually be relevant
for small molecules. The momentum in the market is sound and indicates that there is a real need for
assays that meet these new requirements.

# [Mitigating Disease by Testing Wastewater at Large Events][51]

Posted on [July 15, 2026July 16, 2026][52] by [Parker Smith][53]

The FIFA World Cup has drawn fans from dozens of countries around the world to the United States,
making it one of the largest international sporting gatherings in history. With thousands
of people gathering together, it’s important for scientists and public health professionals to track
contagious diseases. These pathogens spread easily, which is why early detection matters. 

Testing everyone who comes into an event is impractical, and if you wait too long, the disease may
have already spread. How then do scientists preemptively use wastewater to check for disease spread
without testing every individual?  

### **How do scientists test for wastewater?** 

[Wastewater surveillance, or wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE),][54] is a rapidly growing field
that has recently proved effective in tracking the spread of diseases in communities around the
world. WBE refers to the process of analyzing the wastewater output from a population to detect the
presence of certain compounds or pathogens. Though its use became widespread during the pandemic, it
continues to show utility in monitoring other infectious diseases as well, including polio,
influenza and monkeypox, among others.  

Samples collected from wastewater treatment plants provide a wealth of information, but the output
from individual buildings can sometimes offer more specificity as to where exactly a pathogen is
circulating. Occasionally, viruses that go undetected in samples from a treatment plant are still
found on a micro level in sewage from facilities like hospitals or schools.

# [The Calcium-Platelet Connection in Cancer Metastasis ][63]

Posted on [July 14, 2026July 14, 2026][64] by [Anna Bennett][65]

Most cancer-related deaths from solid tumors aren’t caused by the primary tumor itself, but are the
result of metastasis. Metastasis is the process by which cancer cells break away from the primary
tumor, travel through the bloodstream and establish new tumors in distant tissues. This is a
complex, multi-step process and cancer researchers have spent decades trying to understand and
disrupt the metastatic cascade. What is known: platelets and calcium play important roles in
metastasis. What is unknown: How do these two factors interact?  

Here, we explore a recent study published in *Scientific Reports* by researchers at George
Washington University^{[1][66]}. They investigate how calcium levels influence platelet-cancer
cell interactions and what happens when both factors converge.

# [AI Identifies the Target. Someone Still Has to Validate It.][75]

Posted on [July 9, 2026July 9, 2026][76] by [Elise Johnson][77]

Did you see the movie where Spider-Man files his taxes? Or the one where Wonder Woman sits on hold
with her insurance company while her pasta water boils over? Or where Captain America finds blight
on his tomato plants and drives to the county extension office where he spends fifty minutes with a
seventy-four-year-old master gardener named Marlys then leaves with a handwritten note covering his
soil composition, his watering schedule, and what Marlys calls “the mulching situation”?

No. Because the ordinary day-to-day doesn’t stand a chance next to the saving of the world.

We spend most of our lives in the ordinary. Not because we’re failing to reach the extraordinary,
but because the ordinary is what holds everything together

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

animals.

Learn at your own pace with 7 webinars on dPCR data analysis, dPCR vs qPCR, assay design,
multiplexing and application-specific topics. Only until Aug. 31.
[Register now][107]

### Featured Products - See our favorites

[[Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm]][108]

##### [Clinical nucleic acid extraction, in tune with your lab’s rhythm][109]

Introducing QIAsymphony Connect – coming soon – the next generation of automated IVD nucleic acid
extraction. Built on the trusted QIAsymphony SP platform, it combines proven performance with
enhanced traceability, high nucleic acid yields and connectivity for modern clinical labs.
[See QIAsymphony Connect][110]
[[Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx]][111]

##### [Streamline your clinical PCR workflows with QIAcuityDx][112]

QIAcuityDx is a fully automated digital PCR system tailored for IVD applications. It enhances
diagnostic precision and operational efficiency by reducing hands-on time and ensuring accurate
detection and quantification of important genetic variations.
[Explore QIAcuityDx][113]
[[Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction kits]][114]

##### [Discover the eco-friendlier alternative to our most popular nucleic acid extraction
##### kits][115]

Make your lab more sustainable with our QIAwave kits, now both in 50 and 250 sample sizes. The
QIAwave kits use less plastic and cardboard compared to our standard kits with reusable waste tubes
made from 100% recycled plastic.
[See for yourself][116]
[[Meet the NEW TissueLyser III]][117]

##### [Meet the NEW TissueLyser III][118]

Ensure successful downstream DNA and RNA analysis from the start by effectively lysing your
challenging samples with the TissueLyser III.  Get one for your lab today.
[View instrument][119]
[[QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS]][120]

##### [QIAseq xHYB Viral and Bacterial Panels: High-quality targeted viral and bacterial NGS][121]

Harness the power of hybrid capture technology for high-sensitivity detection and sequencing of
respiratory viruses, sexually transmitted pathogens, bacterial AMR genes and adventitious agents.
[Product details][122]
[[Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits]][123]

##### [Fast-track your RNA-seq with QIAseq FastSelect RNA Library Kits][124]

Go from sample to libraries in <5 hours with a fast and convenient solution that incorporates rRNA
removal, library prep and data analysis.
[Go to product][125]
[[Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel]][126]

##### [Study the spread of mpox with the QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular Panel][127]

Enhance your research and surveillance efforts of the mpox virus with our QIAstat-Dx Viral Vesicular
Panel. With seven viral targets included, you can easily differentiate nucleic acids from multiple
viral pathogens.
[Technical overview][128]
[[Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system]][129]

##### [Work smarter with the QIAxcel Connect gel electrophoresis system][130]

Ready-to-use, easy-to-replace gel cartridges. High resolution, high sensitivity. Process up to 96
samples in a single run. All this power and convenience – in a single gel electrophoresis
instrument.
[Product info][131]
[[QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR]][132]

##### [QIAcuity dPCR System: Fast, accessible and reliable digital PCR][133]

Three things every laboratory deserves. And it is qPCR-like but only better. So, treat your research
to a fully integrated and scalable nanoplate-based digital PCR system, delivering absolute answers
from your samples in two hours.
[Discover more][134]

# BIG NEWS! The Q-View™ Imager Plus has arrived!

**Smarter Imaging. Sharper Results.**

The new **Q-View™ Imager Plus** brings advanced chemiluminescent imaging to your lab with
high-resolution optics, thermal control, and built-in barcode scanning.

Paired with the updated **Q-View™ Software 3.14**, it delivers fast image capture, intuitive
analysis, and customizable reports—streamlining your workflow from start to finish.

[Discover what's new][21]
[Q-View Imager Plus - Pneumo Kit - Software]

## You’re in good company

Just a few brands using Q-Plex™ Technology

[[Quidel Ortho logo]][22]
[[PATH Color logo]][23]
[[Cayman Color logo]][24]
[Image of a Q-Plex kit]

## Multiplex & Singleplex Kits

Our multiplex & singleplex kits are high-quality and low-cost. You can choose from our list of
ready-to-use kits or customize a kit, with our growing selection of biomarkers for human, mouse, and
other species, to fit your research needs.

[Multiplex Kits][25]
[Singleplex Kits][26]
[Q-View Imager Plus - Pneumo Kit - Software]

## Q-View™ Imagers & Software

Q-View™ Imagers combine high-sensitivity hardware with intuitive software to streamline
chemiluminescent imaging and quantitative data analysis for multiplex ELISAs and other assays.

Both Q-View Imagers are powered by **Q-View™ Software**, a robust, user-friendly tool that captures,
processes, and analyzes multiplex ELISA assay data with precision.

[View the Imager and Software][27]

## Accurate & Reliable Data on up to **18 Biomarkers**

Every well on a Q-Plex™ microplate provides accurate and reliable data on up to 18 biomarkers. We’ve
been printing plates for customers in many different research areas for over 15 years.

### Search our Peer-Reviewed Articles Library

Search our publication library for all the peer-reviewed journals and research products that have
utilized Q-Plex™ technology.

[View the Library][28]
[Science Journal icon]
[Image of a Q-Plex kit]

## Custom OEM Products

You can trust us to effectively manage the full development of an assay through the production of
retail-ready multiplex kits that utilize the power of Q-Plex™ for your use or customer base.

[Learn More][29]

## Contact Us

*Reach out to us with any questions you have about our assays, software, or our development process.
We are always happy to chat or troubleshoot to help make sure you find the best partners for your
research.*

# BIG NEWS! The Q-View™ Imager Plus has arrived!

**Smarter Imaging. Sharper Results.**

The new **Q-View™ Imager Plus** brings advanced chemiluminescent imaging to your lab with
high-resolution optics, thermal control, and built-in barcode scanning.

Paired with the updated **Q-View™ Software 3.14**, it delivers fast image capture, intuitive
analysis, and customizable reports—streamlining your workflow from start to finish.

[Discover what's new][21]
[Q-View Imager Plus - Pneumo Kit - Software]

## You’re in good company

Just a few brands using Q-Plex™ Technology

[[Quidel Ortho logo]][22]
[[PATH Color logo]][23]
[[Cayman Color logo]][24]
[Image of a Q-Plex kit]

## Multiplex & Singleplex Kits

Our multiplex & singleplex kits are high-quality and low-cost. You can choose from our list of
ready-to-use kits or customize a kit, with our growing selection of biomarkers for human, mouse, and
other species, to fit your research needs.

[Multiplex Kits][25]
[Singleplex Kits][26]
[Q-View Imager Plus - Pneumo Kit - Software]

## Q-View™ Imagers & Software

Q-View™ Imagers combine high-sensitivity hardware with intuitive software to streamline
chemiluminescent imaging and quantitative data analysis for multiplex ELISAs and other assays.

Both Q-View Imagers are powered by **Q-View™ Software**, a robust, user-friendly tool that captures,
processes, and analyzes multiplex ELISA assay data with precision.

[View the Imager and Software][27]

## Accurate & Reliable Data on up to **18 Biomarkers**

Every well on a Q-Plex™ microplate provides accurate and reliable data on up to 18 biomarkers. We’ve
been printing plates for customers in many different research areas for over 15 years.

### Search our Peer-Reviewed Articles Library

Search our publication library for all the peer-reviewed journals and research products that have
utilized Q-Plex™ technology.

[View the Library][28]
[Science Journal icon]
[Image of a Q-Plex kit]

## Custom OEM Products

You can trust us to effectively manage the full development of an assay through the production of
retail-ready multiplex kits that utilize the power of Q-Plex™ for your use or customer base.

[Learn More][29]

## Contact Us

*Reach out to us with any questions you have about our assays, software, or our development process.
We are always happy to chat or troubleshoot to help make sure you find the best partners for your
research.*

## About Werfen

# Powering Patient Care

In everything we do, we use our passion and long-term vision to develop meaningful innovations that
truly enhance patient care and help create healthier societies worldwide.

[ABOUT WERFEN][62]

# Omixon is now part of Werfen.

On October 16, 2024, Werfen completed the acquisition of Omixon, a privately held company based in
Budapest, Hungary, focused on the development and commercialization of Next Generation Sequencing
(NGS) technologies in transplant diagnostics.

[Learn more][63]
[Press Release][64]

### Our focus on Specialized Diagnostics:

# Hemostasis

Our Hemostasis product line is comprised of *in vitro* diagnostic systems, reagents, information
management and service, used to diagnose and guide treatment of thrombotic and bleeding disorders.
Ultimately, our solutions improve the quality of patient care, lower costs, and assure regulatory
compliance in the clinical laboratory.

[MORE INFORMATION][65]

# Acute Care Diagnostics

Integrated and comprehensive whole blood testing product line helps clinicians and laboratorians
achieve better outcomes, lower costs, assure regulatory compliance and save time in hospital acute
care settings. From cardiovascular operating rooms and catheterization labs, to intensive care units
and emergency departments, our Acute Care Diagnostic solutions address today's healthcare challenges
by improving efficiency and enhancing patient care.

[More Information][66]

# Transfusion

Offering the broadest range of manual and automated solutions, our Transfusion portfolio delivers
results accurately, efficiently and productively. A comprehensive line of serology reagents, fully
automated instrumentation, industry-leading data management software and molecular products, help
ensure donor-recipient compatibility for those in need of a lifesaving blood transfusion.

[More information][67]

# Autoimmunity

Through a dedicated focus on autoimmune in vitro diagnostics and lab automation, we anticipate the
needs of the world's most advanced laboratories and clinics. Our highly accurate reagents and
automated systems are designed to serve labs of all sizes, and they help improve the way patients
with autoimmune diseases are diagnosed, monitored, and treated around the world.

[MORE INFORMATION][68]

# Transplant

Featuring molecular and antibody-based assays and software for specialized HLA testing, our
Transplant products are used to determine pretransplant compatibility between donors and recipients,
and for post-transplant monitoring. By providing high-quality assays, accurate test results, and
innovative tools, we can help change the practice of transplant medicine.

## About Werfen

# Powering Patient Care

In everything we do, we use our passion and long-term vision to develop meaningful innovations that
truly enhance patient care and help create healthier societies worldwide.

[ABOUT WERFEN][62]

# Omixon is now part of Werfen.

On October 16, 2024, Werfen completed the acquisition of Omixon, a privately held company based in
Budapest, Hungary, focused on the development and commercialization of Next Generation Sequencing
(NGS) technologies in transplant diagnostics.

[Learn more][63]
[Press Release][64]

### Our focus on Specialized Diagnostics:

# Hemostasis

Our Hemostasis product line is comprised of *in vitro* diagnostic systems, reagents, information
management and service, used to diagnose and guide treatment of thrombotic and bleeding disorders.
Ultimately, our solutions improve the quality of patient care, lower costs, and assure regulatory
compliance in the clinical laboratory.

[MORE INFORMATION][65]

# Acute Care Diagnostics

Integrated and comprehensive whole blood testing product line helps clinicians and laboratorians
achieve better outcomes, lower costs, assure regulatory compliance and save time in hospital acute
care settings. From cardiovascular operating rooms and catheterization labs, to intensive care units
and emergency departments, our Acute Care Diagnostic solutions address today's healthcare challenges
by improving efficiency and enhancing patient care.

[More Information][66]

# Transfusion

Offering the broadest range of manual and automated solutions, our Transfusion portfolio delivers
results accurately, efficiently and productively. A comprehensive line of serology reagents, fully
automated instrumentation, industry-leading data management software and molecular products, help
ensure donor-recipient compatibility for those in need of a lifesaving blood transfusion.

[More information][67]

# Autoimmunity

Through a dedicated focus on autoimmune in vitro diagnostics and lab automation, we anticipate the
needs of the world's most advanced laboratories and clinics. Our highly accurate reagents and
automated systems are designed to serve labs of all sizes, and they help improve the way patients
with autoimmune diseases are diagnosed, monitored, and treated around the world.

[MORE INFORMATION][68]

# Transplant

Featuring molecular and antibody-based assays and software for specialized HLA testing, our
Transplant products are used to determine pretransplant compatibility between donors and recipients,
and for post-transplant monitoring. By providing high-quality assays, accurate test results, and
innovative tools, we can help change the practice of transplant medicine.

# [write.as]

Type words, put them on the internet.

[Start writing][13]

Write an essay without signing up,
or [sign up][14] now.

[View your posts][15]

## Welcome back to the internet

The internet is for connecting with people. Write.as helps you reach them no matter where they live
online.

Friends and family can read your words without creating yet another account online. They can read in
their browser, via email or RSS, on their e-reader, and on federated platforms like Mastodon.

Read more:

[Starting a newsletter →][16]

[Enabling eBook downloads →][17]

[Joining the fediverse →][18]

[[A preview of a Write.as blog.]][19]

[Read this blog →][20]

## Focus on your words

Write.as is a pared-down blogging platform — a distraction-free place for you to write, and a clean
space for your audience to read.

Instead of content management, we focus on writing. You'll see our editor screen first, every time
you open the app. You can write in Markdown or switch to our friendly Rich Text editor. Your work is
automatically saved to your browser as you write.

[[The Write.as plain text editor screen.]][21]

[Try it out →][22]

### Made for writing

Not complex websites, not e-commerce, not content man­age­ment. Just writing.

### Easy publishing

Press "Pub­lish" to send your words to the web, social me­dia, and sub­scri­bers.

### Ad-free

You'll never see ads while you're focused on your work, and neither will your readers.

## Stay independent

Build a home for your writing, outside of walled gardens and locked-down platforms.

Add your domain name to keep control of your web presence. Make it your own with a custom theme.
Then, know you're never stuck here — you can always export your work, or self-host your site with
[WriteFreely][23], the open source software that powers Write.as.

## Free your thoughts

Built entirely around [privacy][24], we don't track you or gather excessive data, so you can write
exactly what you feel.

Create a professional blog next to one written under a pen name. Publicize your work, or keep it
quiet. [Write anonymously][25], or create as many [identities][26] as you like. On Write.as, you
have full control over who knows what about you.

## Build a home for your writing

Write.as helps you create a blog, journal, or news­letter that readers will love to read. Create a
home for your words, then fill it with writing — by yourself or with others.

### Pro

**$6** per month, billed yearly

For prolific writers. Cus­tomize, build a read­er­ship, and publish however you like.
* Up to three blogs on write.as or your own domain
* RSS feed
* ActivityPub integration
* Micropayments
* Unlimited posts
* Unlimited social cross-posts
* Password-protected blogs
* Private blogs
* Publish to Read Write.as
* Rich text editing
* Email subscriptions
* Photo hosting
* Pinned pages
* Full design customization
* API access
* Command-line publishing
* Email publishing
* Team support

[Start free 14-day trial][27]

Subscribe monthly, yearly, or every [five years][28].

### Team

**$25** per month, billed yearly

For serious publishers. Gather your team and manage content with our op­ti­mized work­flow.
* *Everything in **Pro***
* One shared blog
* Asynchronous collaborative editing
* Team blog access
* Team photo hosting
* Five team members
* User roles
* Post signatures
* E-book export
* Priority support

[Start free 30-day trial][29]

Subscribe monthly or yearly.

## Learn more about us

Write.as is part of [Musing Studio][30], a suite of simple tools for creating and sharing on the
open web. You can also gather writing submissions with [Submit.as][31], share photos with
[Snap.as][32], and socialize with [Remark.as][33].

Read about [our company][34] and [our principles][35], and subscribe to [our blog][36].
